The raid note for Twin Fangs (Mythic), checked against every The Twin Fangs pull (39), each until its wipe was decided (the boss's enrage or half the raid dead) and against the note as it was saved before it began. "p3 1:15" is pull 3 at 1:15.
The note's kick order fits pulls 12-39, not 1-11, which had another: there, Kick #2 left was kicked by Dragepie (15 of its 19 casts), Kick #5 left was kicked by Slushmania (10 of its 13 casts), and Attractîv, named in the note, was in none of them (tanks' kicks on others' assignments left out as backup). Kicks are counted for pulls 12-39 only; soaks and cooldowns for every pull.
